completed_tasks.name: OpenCode runtime API exposure and app wiring

decisions.decision: Keep OpenCode integration constrained to the validated ACP subset
decisions.rationale: Phase 1 probes established the supported request surface, and Phase 3 implemented only that slice.

decisions.decision: Persist OpenCode binding defaults separately from general agent profiles
decisions.rationale: This preserves the profile/binding boundary established in Phase 2 and keeps connection details reusable.

decisions.decision: Use selector-based launch inputs instead of re-entering full config
decisions.rationale: The app can resolve saved profile and binding state directly, which keeps the launch path lightweight.

next_action: After any manual code edits and validation, resume with $gsd-resume-work and start Phase 4 planning or execution from the current roadmap state.
context_notes: Phase 3 is complete and the roadmap already points to Phase 4. This checkpoint preserves the end-of-phase-3 state before manual edits so resumption can pick up from a clean boundary.
